title: Entity
description: Adds a CRUD for one entity of a domain, built only from the kit of @link-loom/react-sdk: a list (ListSurface with search, view modes, pagination and row actions from the standard catalog), the record (EntityRecordDialog over the list and its own page, where creating is the record before it exists and fields are edited in place), a service on BaseApi, its routes, the sidebar row, the Omnisearch category, en/es copy and the tests. Nothing is inferred: choose the list preset and the actions.

domain.description: Domain in kebab-case, the folder the entity lives in, as in the backend (e.g. inventory, security)

entity.description: Entity in kebab-case and singular (e.g. product, api-key)

plural.description: Plural for the route (/<domain>/<plural>). Defaults to the English plural of the entity

singularEn.description: English label, singular (e.g. "Product", "API key"). Defaults to the entity name

singularEs.description: Spanish label, singular (e.g. "Producto", "Clave de API"). Without it the English label is used and a warning asks for it

genderEs.description: Grammatical gender of the Spanish noun, so the copy agrees (Nuevo producto, Nueva clave de API)

descriptionEn.description: One sentence under the list title, in English. Defaults to "The <plural> of your organization."

fields.description: Fields as name:type[=values][:flag...]. Types: text, longtext, number, date, boolean, email, url, options=a|b|c, secret (made by the server: shown masked, copied, never typed). Flags: required, readonly, list (show as a column). The first field is the record's title and must be text; name it `name` so Omnisearch can show it

fieldLabelsEn.description: English labels as field=Label, and option labels as field.value=Label. Missing ones come from the field name

fieldLabelsEs.description: Spanish labels as field=Etiqueta and field.value=Etiqueta

list.description: standard: header with description, search, table and grid. compact: table only, no description or grid. cards: grid first, table on demand

actions.description: Row actions from the standard catalog: quickview (the record over the list), edit (the record, ready to edit), open-page, open-new-tab, copy-id, copy-link, delete (with a confirmation)

rowClick.description: What clicking a row opens: the record over the list, or its own page

customActions.description: The entity's own actions as id:kind. call: POST { id } to <endpoint>/<id>. replace: create a new record with the same values and delete this one (a rotation). copy:<field>: copy a field. Secret fields get their copy action without asking

actionLabelsEn.description: English labels of the custom actions as id=Label; a catalog action may be renamed the same way (delete=Revoke)

actionLabelsEs.description: Spanish labels of the custom actions as id=Etiqueta (delete=Revocar)

endpoint.description: Backend path of the entity under VITE_APP_BACKEND_URL (Link Loom contract: GET <endpoint>/<queryselector>, POST, PATCH and DELETE <endpoint>). Defaults to /<domain>/<entity>

scope.description: organization: the list asks for the records of the person's organization (queryselector organization-id) and creating sends organization_id. Such a list has no text search and no Omnisearch category

createDefaults.description: Fixed values sent when creating, as field=value; {slug} is the app's slug (e.g. project_id={slug})

icon.description: Icon of the entity in the sidebar, Omnisearch and the list header (Outlined icons of @mui/icons-material)

section.description: app: a row of its own in the sidebar. advanced: it lives under Advanced settings (no sidebar row; the breadcrumb starts at Advanced settings)

navigation.description: Adds the list to the sidebar, before Advanced settings (only with section app)

omnisearch.description: Adds an Omnisearch (⌘K) category that searches this entity (not with scope organization); results are titled by the first field, whatever its name (name, display_name…)

replace.description: Regenerate an entity that already exists: its files are written again from these options, and its sidebar row, Omnisearch category, + menu entry and copy are replaced. Hand edits to its files are lost
